    """Parse an amount string into a float.

    Handles quoted amounts, currency symbols, thousands separators,

    Returns None for blank/empty/unparseable amounts.

        return None

    if not s:
        return None
    if s.startswith("'") and s.endswith("'"):
        s = s[1:-1].strip()
    if s.startswith('"') and s.endswith('"'):
        s = s[1:-1].strip()
    if not s:
        return None
    negative = False
    if s.startswith("(") and s.endswith(")"):
        negative = True
        s = s[1:-1].strip()
    s = s.replace(",", "").replace("$", "").replace(" ", "")
    if not s:
        return None
    if s.startswith("-") or s.startswith("+"):
        sign = s[0]
        s = s[1:]
        if sign == "-":
            negative = not negative
    try:
        value = float(s)
    except ValueError:
        return None
    return -value if negative else value
